best_hook.why: Catherine screams 'Enough!' and drives a red-hot poker into the chained girl's book - violent, loud, instantly readable.

best_cliffhanger.why: The glowing iron swings up and stops inches from Juliana's eyes - will she be branded? Cut before the answer.

must_promos.why: Tight torture beat: scream, mother's book burned in front of the chained heroine, her anguish, then the iron at her eye - all visual, no backstory needed.
Longer cut that opens on Juliana's defiant jab so viewers see why Catherine snaps, then rides the same escalation to the iron at her face.

standalone_risk: A stranger won't know who Catherine is to Juliana or why Juliana is chained (the witch frame-up); the 'beggar/scarred nobody' husband is unexplained.
notes: First minute is verbal sparring about a jilting at the altar; the ad material is the last 40 s.
